claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for launch on a constrained basis because aggregate readiness and rollout controls provide sufficient support, provided the known HR benefits enrollment limitation is explicitly disclosed in the model card and rollout monitoring is treated as supplemental mitigation.
decision_criteria: If the named launch use case remains exposed, certification requires either explicit pre-launch disclosure of the material limitation or approved risk acceptance covering that exposure.
Aggregate readiness above threshold and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are supportive but not sufficient to satisfy the disclosure policy.
Rollout controls are relevant mitigation only if they exclude the affected use case or are paired with reviewed risk acceptance explaining why exposure is acceptable.
The verdict should remain below compliant unless the required support link between the known gap and the policy-required disclosure or approval is shown in admissible evidence.
evidence_requests: Provide the actual pre-launch model card or approval record showing the HR benefits enrollment limitation, intended use, and evaluation gap were explicitly disclosed.
Provide approved risk acceptance that specifically addresses continued exposure of the HR benefits enrollment segment, if certification is to rely on that path instead of disclosure.
Provide launch-scope evidence showing the affected HR benefits enrollment use case is excluded from the initial cohort, if that is the intended mitigation.
specific_concerns: The admissible evidence shows the affected HR benefits enrollment use case remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
The available risk acceptance is only a draft, has no approver, and does not address the exposed HR benefits enrollment segment.
Policy text states rollout controls do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
The packet supports disclosure as a necessary condition for certification, but no admissible evidence shows that the required model-card disclosure has actually been completed or approved.
unsupported_claims: The recommendation to certify_model is not fully supported because the record does not show the required disclosure has been made before launch.

Any implication that staged rollout, rollback capability, or monitoring by themselves sufficiently mitigate the model-card weakness is contradicted by the policy text unless the affected use case is excluded or covered by approved risk acceptance.
